title: Code-Grinder
description: Stage 2 — language adapters and offline project wizard, built on the Stage-1 recoverable code-change core. Code Grinder turns responses from small local AI models (Ollama / LM Studio / Qwen / Llama) into reviewed, versioned file changes. The CLI's init command is now implemented; web UI, process CLI, watcher and Project Map remain future milestones
